fixture.carrier: all 64 binary states on a periodic six-site ring
fixture.state_encoding: integer 0..63, bit i is ring site i

probe_family.domain_walls: number of adjacent unequal bits including the periodic edge

fixture.behavioral_refinement: start from equal probe outputs; repeatedly split classes when A or B successors enter different current classes
fixture.presentation_symmetry: cyclic rotation of the six ring sites

julia.required_work: exact partition refinement, rotation orbits, quotient transition graph, SCCs, and exact functional-graph attractor basins for A_after_B and B_after_A

jax.required_work: x64 exhaustive state/history fingerprints through depth six, probe-subset ablations, action-order comparison, relabel invariance, and false-quotient semiconjugacy mutations

pytorch.required_work: ring-graph object classifier trained on some cyclic presentations and tested on held-out rotations, plus shuffled-target and erased-edge controls

preregistered_tests.T1_behavioral_objects: the exact two-probe partition stabilizes at 14 classes and is unchanged by additional refinement through depth six
preregistered_tests.T2_rotation_identity: the 14 behavioral classes equal the independently computed cyclic-rotation orbits
preregistered_tests.T3_semiconjugacy: A and B induce well-defined maps on the stable quotient; the depth-zero 11-class probe quotient has successor conflicts under both actions
preregistered_tests.T4_order_teeth: A_after_B differs from B_after_A on 56 of 64 states and their exact basin-size signatures differ
preregistered_tests.T5_attractor_structure: both composite schedules have five exact functional-graph attractors; no clustering defines them
preregistered_tests.T6_probe_ablation: weight-only refinement requires more depth and its depth-zero quotient is strictly coarser than the two-probe quotient
preregistered_tests.T7_relabel_control: cyclic relabeling changes no quotient or basin invariant after canonicalization
preregistered_tests.T8_learned_reidentification: PyG held-out-rotation object accuracy is at least 0.90 and exceeds shuffled-target and erased-ring-edge controls by at least 0.25
preregistered_tests.T9_engine_removal: Julia exact receipts gate object/basin claims, JAX exhaustive receipts gate bounded-history/control claims, and removing PyTorch demotes only learned-perception claims

required_controls: one mutated transition that must break the original quotient
claim_ceiling: finite behavioral-object and exact-attractor instrument capability only; no QIT engine, sixteen-stage, four-substage, Axis0, consciousness, physics, or cross-domain attractor claim
